reviewMethod: Coding Orb read actual common-attribute sections and page-progression/alias definitions; closes unmarked definition gaps missed by the draft, not a feature execution or Droid review.

constraints.reason: Base direction applies to carrying element textual content/attribute values and descendants.
constraints.applicability: Package metadata direction; does not imply content-document direction inheritance.
constraints.phase: T2 semantic preservation; T4a metadata; S2-S4 bidi rendering

constraints.reason: Independent ltr allowed value and meaning.
constraints.applicability: When package metadata dir is ltr; descendant overrides remain possible.
constraints.phase: T2 preservation; T4a metadata; S2-S4 bidi rendering

constraints.reason: Independent rtl allowed value and meaning.
constraints.applicability: When package metadata dir is rtl; descendant overrides remain possible.
constraints.phase: T2 preservation; T4a metadata; S2-S4 bidi rendering

constraints.reason: Independent auto allowed value uses Unicode Bidi Algorithm.
constraints.applicability: When dir=auto; explicit auto does not inherit a parent's dir.
constraints.phase: T2 preservation; T4a metadata; S2-S4 Unicode bidi processing

constraints.reason: Omitted OR invalid dir both default to auto, not to a forced ltr/rtl value.
constraints.applicability: Reading-system package metadata processing on omitted/invalid attribute.
constraints.phase: T4a metadata parsing; S2-S4 bidi rendering

constraints.reason: dir element-placement constraint, separate from its meaning and values.
constraints.applicability: When dir is authored in the package vocabulary.
constraints.phase: T2 structural validation; T4a metadata authoring

constraints.reason: href is a valid resource URL string; subsequent marked prohibition is separately retained.
constraints.applicability: Package item/link href attributes.
constraints.phase: T2 references; T3 migration; T4a maintenance

constraints.reason: href allowed elements are independently constrained.
constraints.applicability: When href is used in the package vocabulary.
constraints.phase: T2 structural validation; T4a maintenance

constraints.excerpt: The ID [xml] of the element, which MUST be unique within the document scope.
constraints.reason: ID datatype/document scope definition, associated with but not replacing marked uniqueness MUST.
constraints.applicability: Package document IDs, not a whole-book global ID namespace.
constraints.phase: T2 identity/references/validation; T4a maintenance

constraints.reason: id has its own allowed-element usage list.
constraints.applicability: Package vocabulary id attributes.
constraints.phase: T2 structural validation; T4a maintenance

constraints.reason: media-type means the referenced resource's type AND format.
constraints.applicability: Package referenced resources; resource-dependent format checks remain separate.
constraints.phase: T2 resource validation; T4a maintenance

constraints.reason: media-type permitted package elements.
constraints.applicability: When media-type is used in package vocabulary.
constraints.phase: T2 structural validation; T4a maintenance

constraints.reason: properties is a space-separated property-value list, not one arbitrary string.
constraints.applicability: Package item/itemref/link property expressions; element vocabulary governs tokens.
constraints.phase: T2 semantic model; T4a maintenance

constraints.reason: Reserved vocabulary is selected per element, not a single unqualified vocabulary.
constraints.applicability: When processing package properties values.
constraints.phase: T2 semantic model; T4a maintenance

constraints.reason: properties allowed-element usage list.
constraints.applicability: Package vocabulary properties attributes.
constraints.phase: T2 structural validation; T4a maintenance

constraints.reason: refines allowed only on link/meta, independently of association/chain semantics.
constraints.applicability: When authoring package refinements.
constraints.phase: T2 association/structural validation; T4a metadata

constraints.reason: xml:lang permitted package vocabulary elements; language tag requirement already separately mapped.
constraints.applicability: Package metadata language attributes.
constraints.phase: T2 structural validation; T4a metadata

constraints.excerpt: The page-progression-direction attribute sets the global direction in which the content flows.
constraints.reason: Global progression definition omitted from initial draft; content/user overrides in following paragraph remain applicable.
constraints.applicability: Spine progression, not character bidi direction; related rendering checks require S3/S4.
constraints.phase: T4a spine parsing/preservation; S3-S4 progression rendering

constraints.excerpt: Allowed values are ltr (left-to-right), rtl (right-to-left) and default.
constraints.reason: Progression allowed-value grammar separate from global direction meaning.
constraints.applicability: When page-progression-direction is supplied.
constraints.phase: T4a spine parsing/preservation; S3-S4 progression rendering

constraints.excerpt: When EPUB creators specify the default value, they are expressing no preference and the reading system can choose the rendering direction.
constraints.reason: default means no creator preference, not unconditional ltr.
constraints.applicability: When creator specifies default; remaining reading-system defaults/overrides still apply.
constraints.phase: T4a spine parsing/preservation; S3-S4 progression rendering

constraints.reason: center is a spread-none alias; aliases cannot be discarded merely because an old RS anchor vanished.
constraints.applicability: When rendition:page-spread-center is used; bind to RS spread-none MUST NOT synthetic spread and SHOULD centered viewport separately.
constraints.phase: T4a preservation; S3-S4 layout/rendering

constraints.reason: rendition:page-spread-left aliases page-spread-left; distinct allowed value and left slot meaning.
constraints.applicability: When this itemref property is used in a two-page spread.
constraints.phase: T4a preservation; S3-S4 layout/rendering

constraints.reason: rendition:page-spread-right aliases page-spread-right; distinct allowed value and right slot meaning.
constraints.applicability: When this itemref property is used in a two-page spread.
constraints.phase: T4a preservation; S3-S4 layout/rendering

constraints.reason: Each layout/default/override definition is independently decidable; reflowable and pre-paginated have different pagination meanings.
constraints.applicability: When the corresponding rendition layout property or item override is present; default and user/reading-system processing rules remain separate.
constraints.phase: T4a property preservation; S3-S4 fixed/reflowable rendering

constraints.reason: Each landscape/portrait/auto and item override has a separate value meaning; auto is the default without creator orientation constraint.
constraints.applicability: Fixed-layout orientation properties under the surrounding profile; definition prose does not upgrade reading-system SHOULD to MUST.
constraints.phase: T4a property preservation; S3-S4 orientation rendering

constraints.reason: Separate none/landscape/portrait/both/auto and override meanings; portrait and spread-portrait are expressly deprecated rather than erased.
constraints.applicability: When the matching rendition spread value is used; deprecated legacy semantics require the cited legacy definition before implementation.
constraints.phase: T4a property preservation; S3-S4 spread rendering/legacy profile

constraints.reason: Each paginated/scrolled-continuous/scrolled-doc/auto and override has separate overflow and spine-transition semantics; source marked block-direction recommendation stays separately mapped.
constraints.applicability: Reflowable overflow handling; RS must ignore flow/overrides for pre-paginated items. User preferences remain applicable.
constraints.phase: T4a property preservation; S3-S4 pagination/scroll interaction

constraints.reason: Four separate non-core font/link/track/video exemption classes; exemption from fallback does not prove playback support. The video note is guidance, not a codec mandate.
constraints.applicability: For an existing resource in the corresponding referenced element/class; font preservation does not authorize adding font embedding.
constraints.phase: T2 resource/reference validation; T5 CSS and preserved fonts; S2-S4 media rendering

constraints.reason: Distinct META-INF file roles; encryption.xml is mandatory when font obfuscation is used. Optional/reserved files are not all required.
constraints.applicability: OCF abstract container, with detailed file schemas and profiles independently retained.
constraints.phase: T1a/T1b container reading; T2 byte preservation; T4a packaging; T6 export

constraints.reason: toc/page-list/landmarks mean different navigation aids; toc alone is obligatory, page-list relates to statically paginated source, landmarks to points of interest.
constraints.applicability: Navigation document types, without converting optional aids into mandatory features.
constraints.phase: T2 references; T4a navigation; T4b splitting; S3-S4 navigation UI

constraints.reason: Separate slash and dot-dot root-URL invariants under the preceding EPUB creator MUST-assume sentence; neither property may be lost in the enclosing paragraph record.
constraints.applicability: Creator assumptions about implementation-defined OCF root URL; reading-system assignment must honor both. This is not a blanket ban on every absolute external URL.
constraints.phase: T2 URL/reference checks; S2 resource service; S4 isolation/leakage regression
